translation:
The time limit has reached zero. This is "Time's
Up.”

Normally the menu would appear now, and you
would be presented with the options to…

…try again and start the Puzzle Phase over,
load a save, or return to the title screen.

But just this once, you can continue from
where you left off.

If this were a Puzzle Phase in the main story,
this would be game over instead.
So please be careful.

You've run out of time this time, but for future
reference…

…here are some hints to help you achieve
victory in the Puzzle Phase.

1. Try to keep the Haruhi Meter as far to the
right as possible.

By moving the Haruhi Meter to the right, you
can directly increase your bonus time limit.
In addition to that…

…it has an effect on the Haruhi Route on the
top screen.

The higher the Haruhi Meter, the number and
positioning of event points that allow you…

…to delay Haruhi become more advantageous.
So be mindful of keeping the…

…Haruhi Meter as far to the right as possible
in the Investigation Phase.
2. Acquire as many Topics as possible.

Especially Asahina, Nagato, and Koizumi's
Topics, called Character Topics.

By collecting these, you can power up the
playable character, or, by using them…
…double the Delay effect.

When you use a Character Topic to delay, you
will lose the effect of their power-up.

So while searching, think about whose topic to
use in your situation…

…and formulate a strategy. That way you will
be able to…
…maximize the use of your Character Topics.
3. Try to search as efficiently as possible.

Overlapping your searches, or using point
search on every tile…
…will only serve to lose you time.

Until you become more experienced, press the
Y button to pause each time you search…

…and review the complete map while you think
about the best action to take next.
4. Acquire "Main Topics.”

When an Accident occurs, the time limit is
decreased dramatically.

If you acquire a Main Topic, you will be able to
avoid that basic penalty.

When it comes to distributing your group
members, sending Kyon alone…

…will allow you to acquire all of the Main Topics
along that route.

It's generally a good idea to check each of
the available Main Topics…
…on each route.

For those saying "I can't beat it no matter
what!” or "I want to progress faster!”…

…select "Puzzle Phase” from the system
settings in the config menu.

From there you can turn on "Topic Stock
Mode.”

In each Puzzle Phase, you'll be able to bring in
all of the usable topics that…
…you have obtained.

If you play the Puzzle Phase a few times and
save the data, you will have plenty…

…of topics to bring to use in the Puzzle
Phase.
If you turn "Topic Stock Mode” on…

…it will have no other effect on the game's
content.
